source.head: 5b524d1: test-only after the release (stopped-run outside check walks the ladder; crash between intent and send -> one labelled repeat). Added while the mutation run was in progress.

steering: INCOMPLETE governs; do not convert author COMPLETE wake into acceptance. No live/promotion.

Check entire preregistered checklist, especially actual recurrence-after-ack then resolution before watcher runs. Pinned watcher limitation conflicts with required suppression; classify explicitly, no waiver by source parity.
Verify unbounded exec retries and ambiguous exec crash repeats against one-labelled-repeat ceiling; claimed durable registration is not human ack.
Determine responder authentication actually enforced; literal claude alone is not proof of identity. Test wrong/rebound identity.
Distinguish deployable campaign config ladder from missing required default; validate exact prospective config rather than assuming it exists.
Reproduce surviving deadline/renewal mutants; invalid or unapplied mutants are not caught. Verify tests-only postbuild additions against release bytes appropriately.
Stopped-run unit-only coverage is not real-process witness. Live/prep held is expected, not an author defect.
Return bounded defect list and smallest repair scope; no author edits, no scope expansion. Wake Tern immediately.
